purpose: Teach: 文中/合弁/集大成/係長/特設/別冊/交替/年率

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の文中、引用ミスがないか確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the paper text for citation errors.
lines.style: Composed, direct task assignment. Clear enunciation on the speaker's name. Measured pace, no rush. The authority of someone who expects competence and sees it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。他大学との合弁研究の合意書を準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the joint research agreement with the other university.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Quick uptake — he's already working on it. Slight eagerness underneath the formality, wanting to show he's on top of things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士論文を研究の集大成として書け
lines.en: Ren — write your doctoral dissertation as the culmination of your research.
lines.style: Weighted directive. Slower than the first line. Eyes forward. Not instruction but challenge — a hand pushing him toward something larger than he's thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の係長相当の先輩に相談しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already consulted with the senior researcher who oversees our lab section.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Careful, showing he's thought ahead. Slight uncertainty underneath — hoping this is the right approach. Polite rising cadence at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会会場の特設ポスター展に出せ
lines.en: Ren — submit it to the special poster exhibition at the conference venue.
lines.style: Crisp instruction, slightly urgent undertone. Weight on the verb. Not a suggestion. The tone of someone opening a door for him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文集の別冊で要約版を出します
lines.en: Yes. I'll publish a condensed version in the supplementary journal issue.
lines.style: Methodical, showing the plan is already half-formed. Slight self-assurance here — he's thought it through. Even pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、夜間研究の交替体制を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — confirm the shift rotation system for the night research schedule.
lines.style: Practical task. Steady, no-nonsense tone. Quick delivery, like checking items off a list. The baseline instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の年率比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I've already included the annual research funding comparison in the paper.
lines.style: Soft closing. A breath of relief — one more thing done. Quiet pride underneath. Trailing slightly, like he's mentally moving to the next task already.
